diagram_previews.alt: Equilateral triangle divided into 16 mini-triangles (n = 4). Thirteen shaded triangles are numbered 1 to 13 along a chain, joined by short red segments: from the top triangle down to the second row going left, along the third row to the right, and along the bottom row to the left. Three up-pointing triangles are left unshaded.
